name: LordOS Studio
title: Camera
backgroundHint: Puts a picture or a short video behind you. Pictures and videos marked ↓ are downloaded when you choose them.
busy: Another app is using the camera directly.
unavailable: LordOS Studio is not available on this computer.
howTo: Apps that choose the “LordOS Studio” camera get these effects.
cameraHint: The camera LordOS Studio takes the picture from.
everyAppHint: Install LordOS Studio Camera from the Store so browsers and other apps can choose the “LordOS Studio” camera too.
everyAppOn: Browsers and other apps can choose the “LordOS Studio” camera. Your camera turns on only while one of them uses it.
everyAppOff: Apps that chose “LordOS Studio” see a “camera off” picture, never your camera.
stopped: LordOS Studio’s camera kept stopping and was turned off. Turn it off and on again to try once more.
pickAny: Choose a picture or a short video
creditsHint: Each background’s title, author, license and source.
greenHint: For a real green or blue screen behind you: its colour is cut out more precisely than without one.
lightHint: Brightens your face and dims what is behind you a little.
stageHint: Keeps you in the middle of the picture as you move.
filtersHint: A look for the whole picture.
retouchHint: Softens your skin a little. The shape of your face never changes.
faceless: This needs LordOS Studio’s face model, which isn’t installed.
micHint.voice: Removes the noise around you so only your voice is heard. If your voice sounds robotic, turn off the call app’s own noise suppression.
micHint.wide: Your microphone with no processing at all: for music and every sound in the room.
micUnavailable: Voice Isolation appears after you sign out and in again.
